LanguageData.Gun_American-180_RWP.description: The American-180 is a remarkable submachine gun renowned for its high-capacity magazine and astonishing rate of fire. Designed for continuous, suppressive action, it features .22 Long Rifle rounds, allowing it to unleash a relentless barrage with minimal recoil. Ideal for keeping enemies under pressure, its compact design and rapid firing make it a unique choice for crowd control and defensive strategies.
